name: Monsters Raid ~Ma ni Ochiru Himekishi~
original_name: モンスターズ・レイド ～魔に堕ちる姫騎士～
source:
In the distant past, a demon king led monsters in terrorizing the land. Despite efforts by powerful individuals from human, elf, and dragon tribes, they couldn't defeat the demon king but managed to seal its power, bringing temporary peace. The three races then settled in different territories—humans in the plains, elves in the forests, and dragons in the mountains. Many years later, as monsters reappeared and attacks escalated, princess knight Celica, a descendant of the hero who sealed the demon king, led a small army to defend the village of Gazette in the Amusha Plains from a horde of monsters.

[Translated from the [url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/mond/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的过去，魔王率领怪物 terrorize 大地。尽管人类、精灵和龙族中的强者竭尽全力，他们仍无法打败魔王，只能封印其力量，为世界带来暂时的和平。随后，三大种族分别定居在不同的领地：人类生活在平原，精灵生活在森林，龙族生活在山脉。多年后，怪物再次出现，袭击也愈发激烈。封印魔王的英雄后裔、骑士公主塞莉卡率领一支小型军队，保卫阿穆沙平原上的加泽特村庄，抵挡怪物大军。

[译自 [url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/mond/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
